nodes.description: Owner address of the blacklist/token, set to msg.sender in constructor and only changeable through changeOwner/updateOwner.
Pending new owner address, written by changeOwner and consumed by updateOwner.
Blacklist mapping address => bool consulted by _beforeTokenTransfer.
Token balance mapping mutated in _transfer, _burn and the constructor.
Nested allowance mapping read by allowance and written by _approve.
Total token supply, reduced on burn.
Token name set once in constructor.
Token symbol set once in constructor.
Immutable token decimals set in constructor.
View returning blacklist status of a user.
onlyOwner function storing a pending owner in _newOwner.
onlyOwner loop writing true into _isBlackListed for each supplied address.
OneSwapToken constructor: sets metadata and mints entire supply to msg.sender.
Public transfer moving msg.sender balances through _transfer.
Spends allowance and moves tokens, decreasing allowance with SafeMath sub.
Adds to msg.sender allowance via SafeMath add and _approve.
Subtracts from msg.sender allowance via SafeMath sub and _approve.
Burns tokens of another account after reducing its allowance; allows blacklisted msg.sender or account to fail.
Batch transfer decoding addresses and values from packed uint256 array elements.
Internal transfer: blacklist hook, balance sub/add and Transfer event.
Internal burn: blacklist hook, balance and totalSupply reduction and Transfer event.
Hook reverting when msg.sender, from or to is blacklisted.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, authorization, blacklist checks and balance operations.
Bit-shift/mask decoding of caller-supplied uint256 in multiTransfer (address = v>>96, value = v&(2**96-1)).
Direct allowance overwrite in _approve without any race-condition mitigation.
Privileged write of a pending owner address (two-step ownership transfer).
Privileged blacklist state mutations in addBlackLists/removeBlackLists loops.
Unbounded loop over caller-supplied array length performing one transfer per element in multiTransfer.
mixedAddrVal packed array argument of multiTransfer.
c = a - b inside SafeMath256.sub with message.
c = a / b inside SafeMath256.div with message.
decreasedAllowance computed from current allowance minus burn amount in burnFrom.
to = address(mixedAddrVal[i]>>96) decoded recipient in multiTransfer.
value = mixedAddrVal[i]&(2**96-1) decoded amount in multiTransfer.
